datasets.name: DebitCurrencyData
datasets.sql:
select
  currency.valute as ID,
  currency.val_name as SName,
  currency.valu_name as Name,
  rates.OSTAT as Rate
from
  avalute currency,
  TEMPRATE rates
where

order by currency.valute

datasets.name: DebitAccData
datasets.sql:
select
  a.ID,
  a.ACC_NO,
  a.VAL_ACC,
  a.NAME,
  t.ostat as Balance,
  t.pok_ostat as LBalance,
  b.CashIncoming as IsCacheAccount
FROM
  Account a,
  Tenostat t,
  Bal_SPR1 b
where
  (A.CLOSE_DAT IS NULL)
  and (a.val_acc = :val_acc)
  and (t.acc_id = a.ID)
  and (b.bal_cn = a.bal_cn1)
ORDER BY ACC_NO

datasets.name: TransactionsData
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  p.ID,
  p.DebitID,
  p.DebitAccNo,
  p.DebitCurrencyID,
  p.DebitCurrencySName,
  p.CreditID,
  p.CreditAccNo,
  p.CreditCurrencyID,
  p.CreditCurrencySName,
  p.DebitAmount,
  p.CreditAmount,
  p.LAmount,
  p.DebitRate,
  p.CreditRate,
  p.DebitBank,
  p.CreditBank,
  p.PackageNumber,
  p.CYPHERCODE,
  p.OPERATIONCODE,
  p.INBALANCECHAR,
  p.OUTBALANCECHAR,
  p.FilialID,
  p.DebitBalance,
  p.Name,
  p.Status,
  p.REJECT_REASON,
  p.TransactionDate
FROM
 TRANSACTIONS p
 WHERE
 (p.TransactionDate between sysdate AND sysdate) AND ( ((p.DebitCurrencyID = 0) AND (p.CreditCurrencyID = 0))
 OR ((p.DebitCurrencyID <> 0) AND (p.DebitCurrencyID = p.CreditCurrencyID))
 OR (p.DebitCurrencyID <> p.CreditCurrencyID)
 OR ((p.LAmount <> 0) and ((p.DebitAmount = 0) or (p.CreditAmount = 0)))
)
 AND (Status in ( 1 , 2 , 3))
  ORDER BY p.ID

datasets.name: ODSCommisionTrans
datasets.sql:
select
    commision_trans.Rowid
   ,id
   ,name
   ,debt
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(debt) as DebitAccount
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(debt) as DebitCurrency
   ,credit
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(credit) as CreditAccount
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(credit) as CreditCurrency
   ,additionalDebt
   ,additionalCredit
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(additionalDebt) as ADebt
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(additionalDebt) as ADebitCurrency
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(additionalCredit) as ACredit
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(additionalCredit) as ACreditCurrency
   ,assignment
   ,commisionassignment
   ,UserID
from
    commision_trans
where
   UserID = 0 or
    UserID = (SBLogin.UserID)
order by
    commision_trans.ID
